reviewNotes: Reviewed all 130 exported keys against the 20 cards in data/pages27-cooking.json and explicit furigana. Context-specific topic は uses わ, directional こめへ uses こめえ, object を uses お. Preserved lexical は in ごはん, はくはん, せきはん, すいはん, はくまい, はいが, はいります, はばひろく, おおはば, はかり, はやく, はし, はたらき and はっこう. ササニシキ becomes ささにしき. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
